free_tier.stated: Zero bytes hosted. Datarade is explicitly a discovery and brokerage layer: it 'doesn't host or deliver data, instead, it focuses on discovery, comparability, and transparency'. Providers list a data product with metadata and a link; the bytes stay wherever the provider already keeps them.

record.tooling: Provider Studio for listings, no storage API. There is no upload endpoint because there is no object store.
record.chaining: None. A listing is metadata; it consumes no quota and provides none.
record.limits_note: fails-quota absolutely. Even the commercial model is commission-only ($0/year + 30%, or $6,000/yr + 20%), so listing is free but delivers nothing.
record.reliability_note: Data marketplace directory platform. Hosts dataset metadata, vendor descriptions, and external links rather than raw data files.

evidence.proved: surfaced with the decisive line: 'doesn't host or deliver data, instead, it focuses on discovery, comparability, and transparency'.
surfaced: 'Pricing that grows with you … Every tier puts your data products in front of them' — listing tiers, no storage tiers.
